newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Coronation gives rights offer details.
newsitem.headline: Coronation gives rights offer details.

text.p: South African fund management company Coronation Holdings Ltd said it was issuing 17.66 million shares in its rights offer to create a new investment company, African Harvest Ltd, with National Empowerment Corp.
A company statement said 1.3 billion rand was being raised, with the "N" ordinary shares issued at a price of 7,375 cents per share.
Last month Coronation said it would retain 250 million rand raised from the issue and 700 million rand would be invested in holding company African Harvest Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
African Harvest, which will have a capital base of one billion rand, will be jointly controlled by NE Corp and Coronation via African Harvest Holdings.
